terminalContract: Add exactly the listed paths, plus the non-governed .github/pull_request_template.md edit and a pointer stub at docs/handoff/1.1.13/ADR-DRAFT-governance-reset.md. The workflow runs one job, `governance / authority`, on pull_request opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review and edited, with contents: read and pull-requests: read, the automatic job token and no repository secret, fetch-depth 0 and the pull request head checked out, and no if, path filter, concurrency or continue-on-error; it ends in success (exit 0) or failure. The checker reads the live pull request, the live base tip and the complete review list through read-only REST calls (Link-header pagination, redirects not followed); requires the checked-out head to equal the live head; takes the changed paths, both sides of renames and copies included, from git diff between the merge base and the head; applies the stricter (highest floor, union of roles) of the base and head policies to each path; treats an unmatched path as R3 governance-owner; accepts a missing base policy only when the pull request adds the policy file; counts a review record only from a principal listed in both policies whose latest COMMENT review on the head carries one complete, non-rejecting nfc-review-record block naming the head with openP0P1 0; adds the roles of the records on the head and of unclassified-path classifications; makes any required or declared role R3; and fails on every error listed in ADR 0080 G1-A. Its job summary records the head, base and merge-base SHAs, the run identity and the Git blob IDs of the workflow, checker, schema and policy at the head and the base tip. It writes nothing to GitHub. Bootstrap (ADR 0080, first introduction): the base 1.1.x has no authority checker, so no base-checker result exists or is claimed, and the check's result on the G1-A pull request is informative only; the gates in force stand in: this record, the base validator, the three existing required checks, the release-owner attestation for the workflow at the final evidence head, an independent fixed-head review, and the owner's GitHub approval naming the governance-owner and release-owner roles with an explicit bootstrap approval. Not in scope: ci.yml, scripts/verify.py, the record validator, scripts/release_promotion_policy.py, .github/CODEOWNERS, a CODEOWNERS generator, the main ruleset and every ruleset change (the owner adds the required context later).
